title: Census view
description: Ephemeral derived Insight ViewModel from traust-core's census view, the denominator authority: for a scope (named products and teams, else every repository) as of as_of, the secure-code work done and the distinct vulnerabilities per corpus ownership class, with declared-IaC and container findings counted apart. Not a persisted artifact or SQL projection. Every serialized field is present. JSON Schema checks structure and ranges, not arithmetic across fields.

as_of.description: The point in time the census is read at: the filter's, else when the view was built.

reported.description: Repositories in scope with at least one finding (false positives included).

dispositioned.description: Repositories in scope with at least one recorded decision.

never_assessed.description: Repositories in scope with no assessment of any kind by as_of.

cuts.description: One cut per corpus ownership class present, in the ownership registry's order (owned, upstream, external-bu, harness-qa), then the cut whose ownership is null: the repositories no product with a registered ownership ships. A repository shipped by products of several classes counts in each.

products.description: The scope's products by slug (the filter's named products, else every product); with a team filter, only those shipping a repository in scope.

cloud_config.description: Findings only a declared-IaC (cloud-config) assessment reported: counted, never folded into the cuts.

container.description: Findings only a container-image assessment reported: counted, never folded into the cuts.

unregistered.description: URLs of the repositories in scope that no product with a registered ownership ships, by URL.

ownership.description: The corpus ownership class, from the ownership registry.

severity_counts.description: Counts by effective severity; unrated counts findings with no severity. Every key is always present.

cut.description: One ownership class's work and distinct vulnerabilities. A distinct vulnerability is one finding reported on its repository's default line, neither a false positive nor hardening.

ownership.description: The class; null for the repositories no product with a registered ownership ships.

audited.description: Of those, the repositories with a default-line secure-code audit.

open.description: Of those, the open ones by severity.

occurrences.description: Default-line reports of the distinct vulnerabilities (a restated finding counts each time).

dispositioned.description: Distinct vulnerabilities with a recorded disposition.

branch_confirmed.description: Distinct vulnerabilities also reported on another branch.

branch_only.description: Findings reported only off the default line, not folded into distinct.

name.description: Raw product name, preserved as data.

ownership.description: The corpus registry's ownership class for the product; null when unregistered.

business_unit.description: The registry's business unit, raw; null when unregistered.

repositories.description: Repositories in scope the product ships.

findings.description: The layer's findings that are not false positives, by severity.
